records.process_description: Master’s theses are usually supervised by a professor; other PhD-holding staff may supervise but are not obliged to. To find a supervisor, consult instructors’ homepages (links via the UZH English Department Staff List) and contact a potential supervisor before booking the thesis online—ideally at the end of the preceding semester, but no later than August 5 for a two-semester fall booking or January 5 for a two-semester spring booking. You must book the Master Thesis online during the module booking period and cannot book without a supervisor. Final submission deadlines are December 1 (fall) and June 1 (spring). Typical length is ~20,000–30,000 words (excl. bibliography); a template cover and discipline-specific guides (Linguistics manual, Literature Guide) and the general module description provide official guidelines. If a supervisor does not reply, send a reminder after one week and, if still unanswered a week after a second message, contact the study advisor at englishstudies@es.uzh.ch.
